structured_output.summary: The diff implements Set.prototype.isSubsetOf faithfully. RequireInternalSlot is done via this_set. GetSetRecord is a local helper that performs Get(size), ToNumber, the NaN and negative checks, Get(has), the callable check, Get(keys) and the callable check, in spec order. Step 4 compares SetDataSize (len) against the size. Step 5 takes thisSize from slots(), which includes empty entries as the spec's List does. The loop in step 7 skips empty entries, calls has with ToBoolean(? Call(...)), returns false early, and refreshes thisSize only inside the non-empty branch, as step 7.c.iv requires. Step 8 returns true. All errors propagate with ?. Spec step comments are kept above the code. The gate report's 14 failures come from other built-ins (Set/Map size getters, Set.prototype.delete) that throw the engine's not-implemented error, which is acceptable. I found no special-casing, made-up values, swallowed errors or unrelated edits. One thing I could not verify from the diff: pop_roots(mark) is skipped on the ? error path, so correctness there depends on with_roots restoring the root stack on exit.
